description.value: A family-run, smoke-free motel sitting directly on the shore of Osoyoos Lake in Canada's only desert, offering 34 rooms — most with fully equipped kitchens — plus a private beach and shaded lawn. The property is open year-round and is well-positioned for exploring the southern Okanagan wine country, desert trails, and cross-border routes near the Washington state line. Staff are described as long-term Osoyoos residents knowledgeable about local attractions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone 250-495-6035, email, address). The /services page is the primary evidence source for amenities, explicitly listing 'Guest laundry,' 'Free wi-fi,' and 'Pub -- across the street,' which confirms laundry, Wi-Fi, and nearby evening food. No mention of bike-specific storage, bike rooms, or staff bike procedures anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating lakeside motel with a live website and online booking; a useful overnight stop for cyclists touring the southern Okanagan.
enrichment_extras.notes: The /services page is the richest amenity source. Bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash) are not mentioned anywhere on the site and would require direct inquiry.
